title: Writing
statusNote: Production draft for the pilot cohort (v2). The task, genre, and guidance are a considered proposal, judged answerable by students from basic level upward: a basic student can state a preference with a single example, and a strong one can weigh depth against breadth and qualify a position. Requires curriculum team sign-off before contentStatus is changed to "approved".
instructions: Write your answer in English. There is no time limit, and you may plan your ideas before you begin.

task.prompt: Some people believe university courses should focus only on subjects directly related to a student's future job. Others believe students should also study a wider range of subjects. Write an essay giving your opinion on this question. Support your view with reasons and examples from your own experience.
task.guidance: Write in clear paragraphs. State your position, give reasons for it, and support each reason with an example. Aim for a well-organised answer of roughly 200 to 250 words; there is no penalty for writing more or less than this.
